cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with overt diabetes based on specific blood glucose (FBS >= 126mg%, RBS >=200mg%) or HbA1c (> 6.5%) criteria.
finding: Overt Diabetes Mellitus is associated with an increased incidence of maternal (e.g., preeclampsia, retinopathy, nephropathy), foetal (e.g., congenital anomalies), and neonatal complications (e.g., hypoglycemia, RDS, hyperbilirubinemia).
mod_finding: No significant association was found between HbA1c levels and operative vaginal delivery.
